chapter3.detail: Runs 20261005-090529, -091617 (enter point), -092125 (teleport), -092651 (trace), and with temporary diagnostics -093310, -093837, -094411, -095004, -095549; aranka.yard -100129; save RRT_Manual_313_Hiriko_The_Trickster.zks. The harness never leaves the loaded lower-gate part (Commander at -146,41,-56; PresenceEnterPoint and RRT_HARNESS_TELEPORT do not reload the area). There Game.State.Units holds only 20 units while LoadedAreaState.AllEntityData holds 1,937 entities (130 main-state), including BlacksmithCapitalTrader at -12,56,-3 and a native AngelTargona at 96,65,7. ResolveTarget reads AllEntityData so the anchor resolves and SpawnUnit succeeds (History.Area unit spawned; the diagnostics showed the copy alive, in game, at the target, not destroyed, and never in State.Units), but Observe reads Game.State.Units, so the next tick finds no copy, the Submitted record plans Blocked and the presence reports failed. F10 group isolation worked (no Fixed conflicting group message after the spawn, only the load-time one); the F9 attribution to that message was a coincidence. Not a spot problem. Needs an area re-entry route for the Ch3 harness or an engine decision (Observe over AllEntityData, which would also expose the native Targona twin at 96,65,7).
